name: lifeos-portal
description: LifeOS Portal — install and launch business operating systems (HospitalityOS first)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/shared && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/env && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/finprove && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/api && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/finprove-engine && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/web && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/business-portal && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/platform-admin
scripts.build:gateway: npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/shared && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/env && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/finprove && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/api
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/shared && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/env && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/finprove
scripts.test: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:web && npm run test:admin
scripts.test:e2e: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/portal-api/test/e2e/portal.test.ts && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/portal-api/test/e2e/portal-ecommerce-install.test.ts && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/portal-api/test/e2e/portal-transportation-install.test.ts && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/portal-api/test/e2e/portal-finprove-unbound.test.ts && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/portal-api/test/e2e/portal-env.test.ts && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/portal-api/test/e2e/portal-gateway-resilience.test.ts && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/portal-api/test/e2e/dev-auth.test.ts && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/portal-api/test/e2e/portal-prod-hardening.test.ts && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/portal-api/test/e2e/migrate.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/shared && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/env && npm run build -w @lifeos-portal/finprove && npm run typecheck -w @lifeos-portal/api && npm run typecheck -w @lifeos-portal/finprove-engine && npm run typecheck -w @lifeos-portal/web && npm run typecheck -w @lifeos-portal/business-portal && npm run typecheck -w @lifeos-portal/platform-admin
